row: Dr. Bob Mason | Active Life NC Chiropractic

Hi, I’m Dr. Bob from Active Life NC Chiropractic in Charlotte, NC! 🌟 I've been helping the local community relieve back, neck, and joint pain, improve posture and mobility since 2012. I strive to help my patients live an active, pain-free life. Subscribe for tips, exercises, and easy ways to protect your spine every day!
